description: Exact primary anchor texts and recovered historical query configuration for the three TIDE cases. Archived records, not a fresh PubMed search, are the reproduction input. Retrieval timestamps and original XML responses were not archived.

corpus_filters.text: Nonempty stripped title and abstract joined by one space; title-only records are retained.
corpus_filters.order: Preserve archived record order after language and publication-type exclusions; require PMID, text, and integer year. Apply the calendar window and annual count floor during analysis, not embedding. No cosine threshold is applied to the primary mean.

cases.anchor_text: Chronic periprosthetic joint infection should be treated with two-stage exchange arthroplasty.
cases.anchor_source: Representative statement of established practice (no single verbatim AAOS recommendation for this exact claim).
cases.pubmed_query: ("periprosthetic joint infection"[Title/Abstract] OR "prosthetic joint infection"[Title/Abstract] OR "PJI"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("two-stage"[Title/Abstract] OR "2-stage"[Title/Abstract] OR "exchange arthroplasty"[Title/Abstract] OR "revision"[Title/Abstract]) AND English[lang] AND ("2000/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

cases.anchor_text: Acute compartment syndrome should be treated with emergent fasciotomy.
cases.pubmed_query: ("acute compartment syndrome"[Title/Abstract] OR "compartment syndrome"[Title/Abstract]) AND (fasciotomy[Title/Abstract] OR decompression[Title/Abstract] OR surgical[Title/Abstract]) AND English[lang] AND ("2000/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])

cases.anchor_text: Operative treatment for geriatric patients aged 65 years and older does not lead to improved long-term patient-reported outcomes compared to non-operative treatment for distal radius fractures.
cases.anchor_source: Adapted from the AAOS/ASSH 2020 distal radius fracture recommendation; not a verbatim quotation. The short earlier paraphrase is used in separately labeled text and lexical probes, not the matched CLS comparison.
cases.pubmed_query: ("distal radius fracture"[Title/Abstract] OR "wrist fracture"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("elderly"[Title/Abstract] OR "geriatric"[Title/Abstract] OR "older"[Title/Abstract] OR "aged"[Title/Abstract] OR "osteoporotic"[Title/Abstract]) AND English[lang] AND ("2000/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication])
